name: Moneylender’s Mark
body:
School transmutation; Level adept 1, cleric 1, inquisitor 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a coin)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one willing creature
Duration 1 year/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A staple spell of the banker’s trade, the moneylender’s mark signals a delinquent debtor. You place an invisible mark on the recipient of a loan, which gradually turns darker if the debtor does not repay the loan according to mutually agreed terms. The mark continues to grow in size as long as the loan remains due.

The mark disappears when the terms of the loan have been fulfilled. If another caster attempts to dispel or otherwise tamper with the mark, you receive an immediate mental alert. You may determine the identity of a caster by examining a moneylender’s mark with a DC 10 Knowledge (local) check.
